name: Suou Miyuri
source:
A mature, beautiful, queen-like girl who has tremendous confidence in herself.
However, she has a soft demeanor towards others and acts with ease and grace.
Because her parents are also investors in the school, her status within the school is extremely high, and she is respected by everyone, both teachers and students.
However, she does not hide her hostility toward the main character, and shows a side where she acts harshly, trying to use her influence to drive him out of the school.

Translated from https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1273918
